title: Farm Friends
kdp_subtitle: Color by Number, Mazes, Counting, Dot-to-Dot and Cute Farm Animal Coloring Pages for Kids Ages 4-8
back_lines: Moo, oink, cluck! The happiest animals on the farm
description:
Meet the happiest animals on the farm!

Farm Friends is a big 8.5 x 11 coloring and activity book made for kids ages 4-8. Every page has bold, easy-to-color outlines and a fun job to do.

Inside you will find:
  • Cute cows, pigs, chicks, sheep, ducks and bunnies to color
  • Color-by-number pages with an easy color key
  • Mazes, counting, dot-to-dot, matching and spot-the-difference puzzles
  • Word tracing and a farm word search for early readers
  • Single-sided pages, so markers will not bleed through
A great gift for birthdays, rainy days, car trips and quiet time.
